header_summary:
Recent updates to the Bitcoin Improvement Proposal (BIP) focus on refining locktime management policies to enhance transaction consistency and privacy across varying implementations. This includes clear documentation of locktime policies and a robust anonymity set to protect user privacy, supported by specific GitHub issue discussions ([Issue #26526](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/26526) and [Issue #35628](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/35628)) and a Core Pull Request ([PR #36040](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36040)) aiming to improve transaction prioritization. The complete draft is available for review at the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/nervana21/bips/blob/anti-fee-snipe/bip-anti-fee-sniping-with-locktime.md).

In the realm of mining strategies, a new approach includes a tripwire proof to deter censorship by requiring adversaries to control a significantly larger portion of the hash rate. This strategy, however, raises several implementation challenges, including the need for a hard fork and consensus for node updates to minimize disruption, which is discussed in detail on [this page](https://gnusha.org/pi/bitcoindev/UW5dOJNFjgt67sz-2sRUPeMJi0XL6_wSm7zKCmSoj_8IzkQavc-Vo9vwiR7Tbaz7bvP2YrH8b-1JGm-9jNQXQM8dqsw1f1Sl75SHIOt9cOc=@proton.me/T/#mb454f49ba0d6ff4b73f4bc28259cf2f9e1f96442).

Michael, known as fanquake, has released a new set of Bitcoin test binaries incorporating the latest glibc version, available across multiple architectures with security features like guix hashes for verification. This effort underscores the community's role in enhancing the reliability and performance of Bitcoin software, details of which can be found [here](https://github.com/fanquake/bitcoin/releases/tag/static_bitcoind_db73d1623957).

The integration of SipHash-1-3-UJ in the Bitcoin codebase marks an advancement in optimizing transaction handling during the block connection process, particularly in the `CoinsViewOverlay::StartFetching` function. This change enhances the efficiency of processing transactions by improving the handling of `earlier_txids` set, as detailed in [this documentation](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35215/changesdiff-f0ed73d62dae6ca28ebd3045e5fc0d5d02eaaacadb4c2a292985a3fbd7e1c77cR386).

recent_posts.summary:

- This optimization streamlines the main thread before parallel speed gains.

active_posts.title: PQ-single-address-backup - BIP-38 for P2MR (bc1z) - 104-char encrypted backup format
